description: Record that an issued invoice has been sent to the customer, by setting its status to Sent. It does not e-mail or deliver the invoice: use it after the user has sent the invoice themselves. The invoice must already be in Issued status. Returns a preview unless confirm=true is set.

confirm.description: Set true to perform the action. Omit or false returns a preview only — nothing is written.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

invoice_id.description: Id of the issued invoice to mark as sent.

name: send_invoice
title: Mark invoice as sent
